reponse: The root cause was disk exhaustion on Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 after the retention change in infra PR #221, which removed size-based retention and left only 7-day time-based retention; the broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC and consumers stalled [2]. Slack confirms the disk at 100% and the broker read-only [3]. The earlier suspicion of the PR #388 batch-size change was a red herring: the revert didn't stop the lag, and #388 was re-applied later [1][3][5]. Impact was 2h47m of delay (09:38–12:25 UTC) with no events lost [2].
